title: Corbell first meets Bob Lazar at John Lear's house
place_text: John Lear's house, Las Vegas, Nevada

tellings.quote: Oh, and he goes, "Lazar's coming over." It's first thing he says to me.

plain: The documentary filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says he first met Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site in the late 1980s, at the Las Vegas house of John Lear, a pilot active in UFO circles, sometime in the 2010s. Corbell tells Michels he was there himself, and that the first thing Lear said to him was: "Lazar's coming over."
